identification: 3 bound volumes of The Examiner (Launceston) newspaper: spine labels read 'Examiner July-Sept 1930', a second 1930 volume (label worn), and 'The Examiner Nov-Dec 1962'. Two 1930 volumes have badly worn, split cloth spines; 1962 volume in brown half-binding is sound. Inside pages shown are 1962 ads (Commer van, Haig, J.R. Green's Green Door paint sale), toned but intact.
